title: Local Business Leads input
description: Pick a type of business and a place. Each business found on OpenStreetMap becomes one row with its name, address, phone, website and opening hours. Turn on website contacts to also read each business's own site for an email, phones, WhatsApp and social profiles.

searchCategory.title: Type of business
searchCategory.description: What to look for. Leave both this and the place empty to run the example (dentists in Austin, TX).

searchLocation.title: Place
searchLocation.description: A city, town or neighbourhood anywhere in the world, e.g. "Austin, TX", "Manchester, UK" or "Westlands, Nairobi". Adding the country helps.

maxResults.title: Max businesses
maxResults.description: Stop after saving this many businesses. Each saved business is charged once.

enrichFromWebsite.title: Add contacts from each business website
enrichFromWebsite.description: Read each business's own website (homepage and contact page, only where robots.txt allows) for a business email, phone numbers, WhatsApp and social profiles. Slower, and charged once more per business whose site lists contact details.

requireContact.title: Only businesses with a phone or email
requireContact.description: Skip businesses with no phone, email or WhatsApp from OpenStreetMap or (when on) their website. Skipped businesses are not charged.

onlyWithWebsite.title: Only businesses that list a website
onlyWithWebsite.description: Skip businesses whose OpenStreetMap listing has no website. On OpenStreetMap a missing website often just means nobody added it.

includeChains.title: Include chains
includeChains.description: Keep branch locations of chains and franchises (listings tagged with a brand). Off by default, since their contacts are usually head office.
